contracts.source: Cerebras press release: Cerebras Powers Ultrafast Mode for OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol (08-13-2026)
contracts.signal: Cerebras powers Ultrafast mode, a new service tier in the OpenAI API for GPT-5.6 Sol, available initially in limited preview to OpenAI customers; Ultrafast runs GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 750 output tokens per second and up to 14x faster than Standard processing. OpenAI (Sachin Katti, VP Compute Strategy): 'We're starting with a small group of customers' and will use those learnings to inform how the service expands.
contracts.units: up to 750 output tokens per second
contracts.type: deployment (OpenAI API service tier, limited preview)
